findings.rationale: blind+edge merged; fixer fx1 extends the rerun roster to the canonical five.

findings.finding_text: MAX_BASE_LEN retune orphans previously-provisioned 51-52-char families: the read-side resolver truncates to 50, misses the legacy family, and re-provisioning would fork a duplicate.

findings.finding_text: leg-lib safeRepoBase/isRerunTarget still truncate at 52 while the provisioner truncates at 50 — long-slug second run mints a junk -2 family and claim patterns misalign.

findings.finding_text: Header claims an overlapping run is a counted success, but the evidence window tolerates only ~5s of overlap; the coalesced test passes via the skew, not the claimed in-flight semantics; docs-grounded semantics (deduplicated means pending duplicate, drain in future) untested at the stale boundary.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: blind#2 + auditor F1; fixer fx2 rewords header to docs-grounded semantics and pins the stale-dedup fail-loud path.
